game_title: Off By One Fixer – Hollow Log Trail Rush
game_concept: A arcade set in Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail, a trail through hollow logs: the wood elf archer must handle cursed treants while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Off By One Fixer: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one.
theme: Mystic Forest – Hollow Log Trail: a trail through hollow logs
core_gameplay_loop: In Hollow Log Trail, repeat each round: Fix range boundaries that skip or overshoot by one. Each round, a new moss bundles challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the fixes value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Collect 100 points of moss bundles by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 100, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Off By One Fixer
